prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 10 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1071; do not mention it.)
text:
This summary is provided for the purpose of documenting the course of care for the patient referenced in this file, a synthetic record created for software testing. The patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, upper and lower back pain, and stiffness that worsened with movement and prolonged sitting. No loss of consciousness was reported. Cervical and lumbar range of motion was reduced, with tenderness over the paraspinal musculature and no neurological deficits on examination. Imaging was not indicated at the initial visit given the mechanism and clinical findings.

Treatment over the course of care consisted of ten office visits. Care included manual therapy, guided therapeutic exercise, posture education, and the application of moist heat and ice as needed. A home stretching program and activity modification guidance were provided. Pain levels improved steadily across the visits, and by the final visit the patient reported near-resolution of neck symptoms with residual, intermittent low back stiffness. Range of motion had returned to near normal limits. The patient was discharged to an independent home program with instructions to return if symptoms recurred or worsened.
